第一步：把牙科保险与一般医保分开: Step 1: separate dental benefits from medical insurance
Medicare.gov 写明：多数情况下 Medicare 不付洗牙、补牙、拔: Medicare.gov says that in most cases Medicare doesn't cover routine cleanings, fillings or extractions, or dentures and implants; a few exceptions, such as dental surgery during a hospital stay, apply. Dental care depends on your dental plan or Medicare Advantage plan, so ask about each procedure, not just "do you take my insurance".
分别问保险计划和诊所：这位牙医在不在你的网络里，现在接不接新病人。: Ask both the plan and the office whether this dentist is in your network and taking new patients now.
问清检查、X 光和后续治疗的保障、自付额、年度上限、等待期，以及是否要事先批准。: Ask about coverage, out-of-pocket costs, the yearly maximum, waiting periods and prior approval for the exam, X-rays and follow-up treatment.
预约时说要普通话、粤语或口译，问清当天能安排的语言；网站有中文，不等于每位牙医都: When booking, ask for Mandarin, Cantonese or an interpreter and what can be arranged that day; a Chinese website doesn't mean every dentist speaks Chinese.
第二步：使用 Medi-Cal Dental 官方查找与求助入口: Step 2: use official Medi-Cal Dental search and assistance
有 Medi-Cal 的，用 DHCS 牙医目录按县查找，可以只看“接收新病人”: With Medi-Cal, search the DHCS dentist directory by county; you can show only dentists accepting new patients and filter for Mandarin or Cantonese, then call to confirm. If none is taking new patients, call the Medi-Cal Dental Telephone Service Center at 1-800-322-6384 (Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.) and ask for an interpreter if you need one. Your medical plan's network is not your dental network.
按县查找，可只看接收新病人的牙医。: Search by county; you can show only dentists accepting new patients.
DHCS 写明：牙科福利变动已延到 2027 年 7 月 1 日。从那天起，19: DHCS says the dental benefit changes are delayed to July 1, 2027. From that date, adults 19 and older who do not qualify for federally funded full-scope Medi-Cal because of immigration status will have emergency dental care only; this is not the end of dental care for all adults. Application timing, current coverage and exceptions such as pregnancy and postpartum each have rules, so take your own notice to the county office or the dental service center.

第三步：费用吃紧时，询问有明确规则的低费路径: Step 3: ask about lower-cost routes with clear rules
NEMS（东北医疗中心）有成人和儿童牙科，接受多种牙科保险。NEMS 写明自己不: NEMS (North East Medical Services) offers adult and child dental care and accepts many dental plans. NEMS says it is not a free clinic: without insurance, or for services your plan doesn't cover, you pay on a sliding fee scale up to the full cost; the discount must be renewed every year or you are charged the full cost. Member Services sets your discount level from your financial documents.
查看 NEMS 牙科与预约入口: View NEMS dental services and appointments
UCSF Parnassus 学生综合牙科诊所接收 Denti-Cal，学生在: UCSF's Parnassus Student General Dentistry Clinic accepts Denti-Cal; students treat patients under UCSF faculty dentists, at lower cost but with longer and more visits. New patients use UCSF's new-patient self-scheduling portal; returning patients call 415-502-5800. Each UCSF clinic has its own rules, so ask about the specific clinic.

预约前准备这些资料与问题: Prepare these documents and questions before booking
带上保险计划名称、会员卡、想处理的问题和以前的牙科记录。: Bring your plan name, member card, the problem you want treated and past dental records.
先要首次检查费和书面治疗计划，再逐项问保险付多少、自己付多少、能否分期；别只比广: Ask for the first-exam fee and a written treatment plan, then what insurance pays, what you pay and whether you can pay in installments for each item; don't compare advertised starting prices alone.
牙痛、肿胀等急诊，直接打给诊所说明情况，问当天怎么评估。: For pain, swelling or another emergency, call the office, describe it and ask how they can see you that day.
